answer: Each identity's work is marked with a violet dye that only forms from real, varied work - like a bloom that only opens in real soil. The work then flows through karst channels underground, traceable to its source: honest work branches through many different channels. From the ridge above, watchers see the pattern: honest dye spreads in many directions, but a farm's dye all flows down one same channel - same color, same speed - because one hand poured it. To pass, a farm must dye a different violet for every sockpuppet, each flowing through its own karst channel - as expensive as honest work.
